free_tier_limits: Free plan is dashboard-only; Tracking API and webhooks not included on Free.

rate_limits: Per-endpoint (e.g. POST /trackings 20/s, GET /trackings 6/s, GET /trackings/:id 5/s); X-RateLimit-* headers.
